messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed the KV/prefix hit-rate panel on infra-main dropped ~10% after a prod deploy. Anyone know where the raw logs/traces live for a quick sleuth?
jon: Which panel exactly? can you paste the grafana link?
mar ia: the top card labeled `prefix hit rate (snapshot)` on infra-main — I saw a step down at 12:03 UTC. panel id looked like 805 in the URL. https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/infra-main?viewPanel=805
ash: For logs: Kibana query `service:kv AND env:prod AND message:*prefix*` — that'll surface prefix cache misses/errors. For traces: Jaeger tag `prefix_cache=true` or search `operation=kv.lookup` and filter by high latency.
sam: Metric to check quickly: `sum(rate(kv_prefix_hits_total{env="prod"}[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_prefix_requests_total{env="prod"}[5m]))` — that's what the panel computes. panel used 5m rate right now.
maria: Do we have an owner on that dashboard? Trying to adjust the alert if this is a transient blip.
lisa: @dash-team usually owns infra-main dashboards. cc @eli who did the recent panel refactor.
eli: yup — I touched that panel last week. I changed the aggregation window to `1m` to catch short regressions, which could be noisy. happy to revert if it's causing flapping.
maria: The alert currently fires when `hit_rate < 0.85` for `3m`. We saw a dip to ~0.80 for ~90s during the rollout. Can we relax so we don't get paged for short deploys?
jon: My vote: keep sensitivity but increase `for` to `5m` so we avoid paging on brief deploys. For severity, route to a lower-sev channel first.
ash: Another option: add a label-based suppression during automated deploy windows (e.g., label `deploy=true`) so alerts are muted during known rollouts.
sam: Quick reproducible query I run locally: `rate(kv_prefix_requests_total{env="prod"}[1m]) > 0 and (sum by (instance)(rate(kv_prefix_hits_total{env="prod"}[5m])) / sum by (instance)(rate(kv_prefix_requests_total{env="prod"}[5m]))) < 0.85` — helps me find affected instances.
maria: Good call. @eli can you drop the dashboard link and PR here when you update? @dash-team can you assign owners and add a runbook link to the alert?
op-bot: Deploy finished: rollout/kv-prefetch v1.2 -> prod at 2026-03-15T12:02:30Z :rocket:
eli: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/dashboards/pulls/317 — reverting agg window to `5m` for that panel and adding a short note to the panel description about deploy noise. I'll also add a link to the runbook.
lisa: assigning owners now: @eli + @ash. I'll file the alert tuning task: https://issues.redwood/INC-4398 and add the suggested `for: 5m` change and deploy suppression option.
maria: Thanks all — I'll monitor the panel for the next 24h and report back if it resurfaces :thumbsup:
